open_points.subject: A20 rule 3 host-platform start proof
open_points.text: A release runs on Linux and on no other host, of any version that runs the sandbox runtime, which the start proves (A03); owner, 2026-10-18. / A20 rule 3 ... [is] outside the running kernel ... which no module owns. / at run time only `sandbox.probe_sandbox` checks that a sandbox works.
open_points.question: Does `sandbox.probe_sandbox` own and perform the new runtime proof that the host is Linux and supports the pinned sandbox runtime, or is the Linux-only constraint entirely a release-build fact with no runtime host check?
options: Make `sandbox` own the host/runtime start proof under A03 and define what successful proof checks
Keep A20 rule 3 wholly outside runtime and state that a successful existing sandbox probe is the complete proof, with no separate host check
Assign the host-platform proof to another named module or release component
open_points.default_guess: Treat successful `sandbox.probe_sandbox` as the complete runtime proof and make `sandbox` explicitly own that part of the new clause.
